name: FI(A) Course Theory — F AIR
description: Theory for the aeroplane flight instructor course at F AIR, Benešov (LKBE): SERA and Part-FCL air law with Czech airspace and LKBE local rules, flight time limitations, piston engine and C152 systems, performance and mass and balance, navigation and radio navigation, VFR procedures and emergencies, and human performance and instructional technique.
